_comment: Hybrid browser navigate policy for Cursor beforeMCPExecution and Claude PreToolUse.
denyHosts/denySuffixes win over allowHosts/allowSuffixes. Unlisted hosts return ask.
allowUrlPrefixes run first and may punch a path hole in a denied host — never prefix IdP/mail/Slack.
allowSuffixes / denySuffixes: host === suffix OR host ends with '.' + suffix.
allowUrlPrefixes: full URL prefix match (lowercased) — ST Google Sites and ST HtmlService /exec.
allowHostEndsWith: literal hostname suffix including the separator (Apps Script iframe -script.googleusercontent.com).
Extend allow* when a recurring QA host is safe to auto-run; extend deny* for high-risk.
After editing, run: npm run sync-rules (repos with hooks:true) from llm-wiki.
